senses.definition: A single manufactured item or product considered individually in manufacturing or trade.

examples.en: The factory produced over ten thousand units this week.
examples.vi: Nhà máy đã sản xuất hơn mười nghìn sản phẩm trong tuần này.

senses.definition: An independent part of a machine or electronic system that carries out a particular function.

examples.en: The central processing unit is the brain of the computer.
examples.vi: Bộ xử lý trung tâm là bộ não của máy tính.

senses.definition: An individual apartment or flat within a larger building or complex.

examples.en: They bought a two-bedroom unit near the beach.
examples.vi: Họ đã mua một căn hộ hai phòng ngủ gần bãi biển.

senses.definition: The number one, or the final digit representing ones in a whole number.

examples.en: In the number forty-five, five is in the units place.
examples.vi: Trong số bốn mươi lăm, chữ số năm ở hàng đơn vị.

thesaurus.definition: any division of quantity accepted as a standard of measurement or exchange
an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole
an organization regarded as part of a larger social group
a single undivided whole
a single undivided natural thing occurring in the composition of something else
an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity

examples: Number, we define, to be, a certayne Mathematicall Sũme, of Vnits. [Note the worde, Vnit, to expresse the Greke Monas, & not Vnitie: as we haue all, commonly, till now, vsed.]
wiktionary.gloss: Oneness, singularity, seen as a component of a whole number; a magnitude of one.

examples: The centimetre is a unit of length.
The pound sterling is a unit of currency.
wiktionary.gloss: A standard measure of a quantity or magnitude.
A basic, self-contained component or module that performs a specific function inside a computer system.
The number one.

examples: He was a member of a special police unit.
wiktionary.gloss: An organized group comprising people or equipment.

examples: We're starting a new unit on photosynthesis next week.
wiktionary.gloss: A course, lesson, or section of a curriculum covering a particular topic or skill.

examples: The fifth tank brigade moved in with 20 units. (i.e., 20 tanks)
wiktionary.gloss: A member of a military organization.

examples: We shipped nearly twice as many units this month as last month.
wiktionary.gloss: An item which may be sold singly.

examples: This air-conditioner is the most efficient unit we sell.
wiktionary.gloss: Any piece of equipment, such as an appliance, power tool, stereo system, computer, tractor, or machinery.
A structure used to display goods for sale (usually containing shelves, pegs or hooks)

examples: The new apartment complex will have 50 units.
wiktionary.gloss: A measure of housing equivalent to the living quarters of one household; an apartment where a group of apartments is contained in one or more multi-storied buildings or a group of dwellings is in one or more single storey buildings, usually arranged around a driveway.
A quantity of approximately 517 milliliters (1.1 U.S. pints) of blood.
Any military element whose structure is prescribed by competent authority, such as a table of organization and equipment; specifically, part of an organization.
An organization title of a subdivision of a group in a task force.
A standard or basic quantity into which an item of supply is divided, issued, or detailed.

With regard to Reserve Components of the Armed Forces, denotes a Selected Reserve unit organized, equipped, and trained for mobilization to serve on active duty as a unit or to augment or be augmented by another unit. Headquarters and support functions without wartime missions are not considered units.
The identity element, the neutral element.
An element having an inverse, an invertible element; an associate of the unity.
In an adjunction, a natural transformation from the identity functor of the domain of the left adjoint functor to the composition of the right adjoint functor with the left adjoint functor.

A volume of rock or ice of identifiable origin and age range that is defined by the distinctive and dominant, easily mapped and recognizable petrographic, lithologic or paleontologic features (facies) that characterize it.
A unit of alcohol.
One kilowatt-hour (as recorded on an electricity meter).
A gold coin of the reign of James I, worth twenty shillings.
A work unit.
A physically large person.
A penis, especially a large one.

blocks.etymology: Formerly unite, a later form of unity; see unity.

senses.definition: Relating to or calculated for each single item or product.

examples.en: Higher production helps reduce the unit cost of goods.
examples.vi: Sản xuất nhiều hơn giúp giảm chi phí trên mỗi đơn vị hàng hóa.

senses.vi: đơn vị; theo từng đơn vị

senses.definition: Having a size, magnitude, or length of one.

examples.en: A unit circle has a radius of one.
examples.vi: Đường tròn đơn vị có bán kính bằng một.

examples: We have to keep our unit costs down if we want to make a profit.
wiktionary.gloss: For each unit.
Having a size or magnitude of one.

idioms.gloss: relating to unit record devices, processes, or media

tatoeba.en: If we place an order for more than 20 units, would you reduce the price?
tatoeba.vi: Nếu chúng tôi đặt hàng với số lượng lớn hơn 20, bạn sẽ giảm giá chứ?

wiktionary.gloss: Not stressed or accentuated.
Not subject to stress.

blocks.etymology: From a longer saying: "A word to the wise is sufficient".

examples: Well have fun, but, word to the wise, don't let your sister take control.
